page_title: CRE 0-0 GEN | Cremonese v Genoa 15/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Crossbar! Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box, but his attempt only rattles the crossbar! The goalkeeper can remain calm.
90+3' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) wastes an opportunity to score with a header from inside the 18-yard box. His effort floats over the bar by a whisker!
90+2' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Genoa.
90+1' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Tommaso Baldanzi (Genoa).
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Amorim (Genoa) replaces Morten Frendrup.
88' Romano Floriani (Cremonese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alessio Zerbin.
84' Simone Sozza has a clear sight and sees a foul from Morten Thorsby (Cremonese).
81' Aaron Martin (Genoa) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
80' Genoa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Genoa are awarded a corner kick.
77' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
76' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Johan Vasquez (Genoa) but poses no threat.
72' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Milan Djuric is replaced by Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese).
72' Substitution. Giuseppe Pezzella did his best and is replaced by Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese).
72' Lorenzo Colombo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).
72' Substitution. Brooke Norton-Cuffy is replaced by Aaron Martin (Genoa).
72' Daniele De Rossi has decided to substitute Junior Messias and he is replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (Genoa).
68' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
67' A snap shot by Morten Thorsby (Cremonese) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Justin Bijlow flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.
66' Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful low volley was directed towards the middle of the net, but Justin Bijlow was alert and made an astonishing save!
65' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 39:61.
63' Close! Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
61' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
60' Substitution. Vitinha makes his way off the pitch and Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) comes on as his replacement.
58' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Martin Payero will be replaced by Alberto Grassi (Cremonese).
58' Jamie Vardy goes off the pitch and Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) comes on.
57' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Milan Djuric (Cremonese), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post.

53' Junior Messias (Genoa) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
52' The corner by Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.

52' Vitinha (Genoa) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
48' Morten Thorsby (Cremonese) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom left corner, but Justin Bijlow is prepared and dives to thwart him.
47' Cremonese take a short corner kick.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Simone Sozza has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Vitinha (Genoa) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
44' Cremonese will take a corner kick.
42' The corner from Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) is intercepted by Justin Bijlow.
42' Martin Payero (Cremonese) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
41' Martin Payero (Cremonese) takes the corner but it's cleared.
41' The free kick is taken by Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese), but ball is cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Cremonese will have a corner.
39' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) latches onto a nice cross into the area around the penalty spot, but plants his header just over the bar.
37' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
34' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Emil Audero.
33' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) makes a strong challenge and Simone Sozza blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Cremonese.
32' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) latches onto a loose ball inside the box, but his first-time strike at goal is blocked by a defender.
30' The corner kick from Vitinha (Genoa) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
30' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Emil Audero makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
29' Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
29' Justin Bijlow makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Milan Djuric (Cremonese) after a cross from the side.
26' Junior Messias (Genoa) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Emil Audero comes off the line to clear the ball away.
26' Morten Thorsby (Cremonese) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
23' Total attempts – 1:4.
20' Martin Payero (Cremonese) is able to continue to play.
20' Rough tackle by Morten Frendrup (Genoa). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Simone Sozza blows his whistle and it's Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

12' Vitinha (Genoa) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. But his low attempt from just outside of the box went straight towards the middle of the goal and Emil Audero made a comfortable save.
11' The resulting corner, taken by Junior Messias (Genoa), comes to nothing.

10' Vitinha (Genoa) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. Corner kick. Genoa will have an opportunity.
9' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Genoa.

8' A snap shot by Junior Messias (Genoa) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Emil Audero produces a good save to thwart him. The referee blows his whistle, Genoa are awarded a corner kick.
8' Morten Thorsby (Cremonese) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
6' Vitinha (Genoa) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
4' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) has tested the patience of referee Simone Sozza and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
2' Emil Audero leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Vitinha (Genoa).

1' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
